title: Nifty 50 tanks 11% in March— Why 'buy-on-dips' may not be the right market strategy now | Stock Market News
summary: Indian equity benchmark Nifty 50 suffered a significant crash due to the US-Iran war, crude oil price surge, and currency weakness, with many stocks plummeting over 15%. The market has been under selling pressure since January, and the recent crash has led to speculation about the market's future direction.
sentiment_reason: The market impact is strongly negative due to the stock market crash, geopolitical tensions, and their effects on the economy and corporate earnings.
